command: name=$(cat -- "$1") || exit 1; range=$(gsettings range org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color) || exit 0; case $range in *"'$name'"*) ;; *) exit 0;; esac; [ "$(gsettings get org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color)" = "'$name'" ] && exit 0; exec gsettings set org.gnome.desktop.interface accent-color "$name"
